verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's hybrid search docs state that it offers native reranking with managed models alongside server-side RRF fusion. The query docs also list late-interaction, ColBERT-style multi-vector ranking. That documents a first-party reranking capability, but only in brief mentions with no detail on which models are available, how to configure them, or what limits apply. missing for 10: list of supported managed reranker models, rerank API parameters and usage docs, limits and pricing, independent or hands-on corroboration of reranking quality.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models

citations.quote: turbopuffer also provides server-side rank fusion via RRF and native reranking with managed models.
Late-interaction: rank documents with multi-vector (ColBERT-style) models
